title: Requirement file frontmatter, version 1
description: The YAML frontmatter of a file under the requirements folder's acceptance/ or invariants/. The folder gives the type, the file name (AC0001__slug.md or INV0001__slug.md) the id, and the first non-empty line of the body the statement.

supersededBy.description: The requirement that replaced this one. Only with status superseded.

source.description: A durable external reference, such as a regulation or an incident number.

scenario.description: A scenario as the requirement file writes it: [AC0001.2] text.
